description: This file defines the SearchIndex class in the Drupal search module, managing search index operations such as indexing, clearing, reindexing, and updating word weights.

classes.name: SearchIndex
classes.description: Provides search index management functions including indexing, clearing, reindexing, and updating word weights.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SearchIndex class with dependencies such as config factory, database connections, cache invalidator, text processor, and time service.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Indexes a piece of content by processing its HTML, extracting words, and updating the search index and dataset tables.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears search index and dataset entries based on optional type, sid, and langcode filters, and invalidates related cache tags.

methods.name: markForReindex
methods.description: Marks specific index entries for reindexing by updating their reindex timestamp.

methods.name: updateWordWeights
methods.description: Updates the inverse document frequency counts for words in the index, removing obsolete words.
